name: Verifed V14.1
description: First Taco Bell app-style menu with purple ordering-style header, searchable categories, item gallery, dietary view and locally drafted ingredient-change requests. Corrected the food-photo bug: removed generic restaurant photos from individual menu entries, recovered 53 exact Loving Hut dish photos from official source HTML, and added the official Taco Bell Cantina Chicken Bowl photo for three branches. Official Taco Bell item photos now cover 54 unique products across 3 branches. No orders or modifications are sent to restaurants.
verification: Image-source tests verify the Taco Bell, Loving Hut and Chipotle exact-photo matches and suppress unrelated representative photos.
Taco Bell menu customization is an unsent staff-request draft; no allergen-free result is inferred from removing ingredients.
The app's 25 active restaurants have incomplete photo coverage; missing photographs are intentionally not fabricated.
Snack publishing now requires an explicit version-matched request; future per-chain GitHub commits do not automatically publish to Snack.
